The '''Percentage Calculator''' is a free everyday percentage tool in the [[SoapBox]] tools suite. It gathers the common percentage questions people actually ask into one small page, with the answer updating as the numbers are typed.

== What it does ==
* '''X% of Y''' — for example, 15% of 200 is 30.
* '''X is what % of Y''' — 30 is 15% of 200.
* '''Percentage change''' — the increase or decrease from one number to another (200 to 250 is +25%).
* '''Add a percent''' — increase a number by a percentage.
* '''Subtract a percent''' — decrease a number by a percentage, such as a discount.
* '''Tip splitter''' — a tip percentage on a bill, with the total and the amount per person when split several ways.

== How to use it ==
Pick the question from the tabs, type the numbers, and the result appears immediately. It runs entirely in the browser; no account is required and nothing is sent anywhere. A JSON API is available at /api/pct for programmatic use.
